messages:
sam: Heads up — storage-node-disk-write-latency alert (prod) has been firing ~every 3m for the last 40m on model-storage-01/02 during the canary checkpoint job. Starting to add noise to the rotation dashboard. Link: <https://grafana.internal/redwood/d/abcd/storage-overview?orgId=1>

oncall-bot: Alert summary: storage-node-disk-write-latency triggered 38 times in 40m for cluster=model-storage-01 (severity=warning)

maria: @sam can you paste the Prometheus query and traces? want to confirm it's checkpointing not user traffic :eyes:

sam: PromQL below. Shows p95 for disk write latency across nodes, spikes aligned with checkpoint windows.
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_bucket{device=~"nvme.*",job="node_exporter",cluster="model-storage"}[5m])) by (le, instance))
```
Trace: <https://traces.internal/redwood/trace/abcd1234> — single long write op from checkpoint-service correlates with the spike.

devon: if it's a known checkpoint pattern i'd rather we route traffic to model-variant-lowprio for a short window instead of global mute. can we do per-node suppression or an exemption rule?

lee: I agree with per-node suppress. If that's heavier to implement quickly, i'm ok with a 30m localized snooze for now. Proposed: bump alert threshold p95 from 120ms -> 300ms for cluster=model-storage and add a 30m mute window scoped to model-storage-01 only.

maria: sgtm for a targeted 30m snooze while we triage. please include the exact matcher and the rollback plan in the PR.

sam: I'll open a quick ops PR and schedule a one-off mute. PR: <https://github.com/redwood/ops/pull/12345> — plan: apply mute at 2069001300 (unix ts) for 30m, scope matcher: `cluster=model-storage-01`, alert name: `storage-node-disk-write-latency`. Also include threshold bump in the same PR with rollback instructions. If anyone objects speak now.

devon: :+1: prefer the per-node suppression long term but ok for emergency. can you also add a note to the runbook to check checkpoint job pacing?

oncall-bot: Mute scheduled by sam at 2069001300 for 30m (targeting alert=storage-node-disk-write-latency, matcher=cluster=model-storage-01).

sam: Done — mute applied, PR merged, and the threshold bump is staged with a 1h auto-rollback if no manual confirmation. Follow-up ticket to add checkpoint-aware suppression: https://github.com/redwood/ops/issues/678.

lee: Thanks all — noise should drop now. Leaving monitoring open for one more checkpoint window. :white_check_mark:
